meta.title: θ Théta · Machine Learning, one concept at a time
meta.description: An editorial series on LinkedIn by Ladji Lama Kamagate: one carousel per concept, as a PDF, plus a 3D journey and a 3D lab.
meta.signature: θ Théta, Machine Learning, one concept at a time.

hero.intro: Short, accurate carousels, one concept per episode, and a 3D lab to play with it. The θ robot takes you from your first model to gradient descent.

profil.t5: A third-year SRIT undergraduate at ESATIC, I work on NLP, conversational agents and software development. θ Théta is my way of explaining Machine Learning.
profil.t10: I learn Machine Learning by building it, and I share it
profil.t11: I am looking for an internship to put my artificial intelligence skills to work for an innovative team, contribute to real projects, and keep improving.
profil.t28: Like gradient descent: each stage brings the right setting a little closer.

legal.conf_l2: What you ask to receive: the PDFs, the newsletter, or a specific PDF.
legal.conf_l3: The date of the request and your consent.
